{07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Go on,{01 00 00 05 00} take it!{01 00 00 0f 00} Someday,

messages.en:
{07 00 00}The {ff 00 00 03}Fishing Tourney{ff 00 00 00},{01 00 00 05 00} as the
name suggests, is a contest
where you fish.
Whoever catches the {ff 00 00 02}biggest
fish{ff 00 00 00} by 6 p.m. {01 00 00 05 00}wins!

So get out there, and if
you catch one, {01 00 00 05 00}come here
and show it to me!{01 00 00 0f 00}
I'll measure it for you.{01 01 00}
Want to hear more?{02 04 00 07 05}
Tell me!
No, thanks.

{07 00 00}Oh, and{01 00 00 05 00} even if you don't

{07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}I'll present you with a

{07 03 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Even the {ff 00 00 06}mayor{ff 00 00 00} needs
